title: Serverless Compute: Cloud Run, Functions, and Workflows — D6
purpose: Shows the documented internals needed to predict behavior; undocumented details are observed behavior and may change.
routing_rationale: Cloud Run provides serverless container execution with automatic scale-to-zero. Serverless VPC Access enables private connectivity to internal VPC databases.

nodes.label: HTTPS Client / Eventarc
nodes.detail: Public web request or Cloud Storage object creation event.

nodes.label: Cloud Run Ingress Proxy
nodes.detail: Terminates TLS; manages container auto-scaling and concurrency multiplexing.

nodes.label: Container Instance
nodes.detail: Isolated sandboxed container handling up to 80 concurrent requests.

nodes.label: Serverless VPC Connector
nodes.detail: Throughput-scalable bridge routing private RFC 1918 traffic from Cloud Run into VPC.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL (Private IP)
nodes.detail: Enterprise database rejecting public internet access; accepts internal VPC traffic only.

steps.title: Serverless Ingress
steps.action: Request arrives at Cloud Run; proxy evaluates container concurrency.
steps.why_traversal: If idle, launches microVM container in hundreds of milliseconds.

steps.title: MicroVM Execution
steps.action: Container processes request in gVisor sandbox; connects to private database.
steps.why_traversal: gVisor provides hardware-grade multi-tenant security boundary.

steps.title: Serverless VPC Egress
steps.action: Packet traverses Serverless VPC Connector into private VPC to query Cloud SQL.
steps.why_traversal: Allows serverless containers to communicate with private enterprise databases without public IPs.

scenarios.label: VPC Connector Throughput Saturation
scenarios.root_cause: Concurrent database queries exceeded e2-micro VPC connector bandwidth limit (200 Mbps).
scenarios.diverted_path: Packets dropped at VPC boundary; Cloud Run returns HTTP 500.
scenarios.blast_radius: Database queries fail under high traffic surge.
scenarios.recovery: Resize Serverless VPC Access connector to min 3 instances with e2-standard-4 machine types.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
